headline: Molson Coors (TAP) Stock Looks Cheap Following Its Premiumization Push
summary: Molson Coors Beverage stock has had a tough run over the past three years, yet the current valuation checks suggest the market may now be pricing it more cautiously than the fundamentals alone might imply. The share price has declined 35.7% over the past three years, which raises the question of whether sentiment has become too pessimistic relative to the underlying business. Efforts to grow higher margin categories through portfolio diversification and premiumization can support earnings...
